column3: Confirm, list and withdraw host-mismatch site pairs from Settings > Advanced > Maintenance (Lane M, R684)
column7: The three R193 host-pair routes had no button. A host-mismatch sample now carries a Confirm site button (this source really publishes on that site), a new Sites you confirmed list shows every pair with its date and note and a Withdraw button, and a visible caveat says a confirmation only changes how the next dry run counts the pair: nothing is marked or removed. Sample rows now carry source_id. Local only; one delegated listener; 13 strings x12. Feature ceiling 68 to 65.
